idea-plugin.name: Model Card Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Lints a Hugging Face model card against the Hub metadata spec and the EU AI Act general-purpose AI documentation duties, line by line.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Model Card Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 28 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/model-card-lint-gpai (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/model-card-lint-gpai

action.text: Model Card Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Model Card Lint on the file in the editor
